posts.content_md:
I just looked at Dinesh's web site and it looks much better in my humble opinion. I also see that he has DCG plates for sale for ONLY $40 for 10. 

I know the work and materials that goes into making those plates and I believe he stated he was originally offering the plates at that price for forum members only. 

Anyway, my point is we advertise Integraf for Supplies and they give forum members a discount. I think the DCG plates that Dinesh is offering is already discounted and maybe we should put a header at the top of the forum pages (like Integraph's) for a link "DCG Plates for Sale" to Dinesh's DCG page. 

Think hard on this because DCG plates are not available anywhere in the world as far as I know (other then year old plates) and with the growing number of green lasers out there, DCG may be an avenue some would persue if they knew where to get plates. 

AND

He supports the forum financially and with knowledge.

Peace to all!
